messages:
jeremy: Kicking off preflight for a blue/green swap of the edge-router pool for svc-embed-prod. Plan: 0 -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m. Change window 13:00-13:30 UTC. tagging @maya @li. release id rel_20260320_38 (pin router-proxy v3.4.2).

deploy-bot: release rel_20260320_38 started by jeremy. Metadata: {version: router-proxy v3.4.2, traffic_plan: [0m:5%, +5m:20%, +10m:50%, +20m:100%], health: /healthz => 200, auto-rollback: 5xx > 3% for 2m} (runbook: /go/releases/edge-shift)

maya: copying preflight checklist: 1) infra alerts muted? 2) canary logs enabled 3) alert thresholds set (5xx 3% over 2m) 4) drain timeout set 120s 5) keep 2 warm instances. pinging @sre-oncall

li: I updated target group: drain_timeout=120s, slow_warm=true (min_warm=2). Also enabled fractional weights (weight-step=5%). LB config pushed to canary routers.

samir: note: pinning model-serving runtime to 2.1.7 to avoid KV-cache invalidation during swap. Confirmed on infra side.

maya: running quick smoke: `curl -sSf "https://svc-embed-prod.internal/healthz" || echo fail` -> OK from eu-west1

jeremy: smoke looks clean from multiple regions. starting 5% now (holding 2m after shift).

deploy-bot: traffic shift event recorded: rel_20260320_38 -> 5% at 1712345710

maya: seeing a small p95 latency bump (~+30ms) on a single edge host, no errors. holding for 2m before next step.

li: adding temporary route override so fallback to stable release can be triggered quickly: `rbctl set-fallback rel_20260320_37` (won't flip unless we call it)

maya: 5% shows <1% 5xx. proceeding to 20% now.

deploy-bot: traffic shift event: rel_20260320_38 -> 20% at 1712345730

samir: model runtime pinned and KV cache warm. metrics look within SLOs so far; token cost bumped but expected.

jeremy: ok proceeding to 50% in 2m. rollback criteria: any region >3% 5xx or sustained error rate uptick for 2m -> immediate rollback. I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: traffic shift event: rel_20260320_38 -> 50% at 1712345745

maya: 50% produced a spike in EU: 5xx ~= 4.5% in eu-west1, identical error patterns from edge-proxy logs (upstream 502s). initiating immediate rollback per plan. calling rollback now. :no_entry: 

deploy-bot: rollback triggered for rel_20260320_38. Rolling traffic back to rel_20260320_37. Reason: 5xx rate exceeded threshold in eu-west1. Remediation actions: re-enable detailed proxylg, collect sample traces, tag for postmortem.

jeremy: rollback completed and verified. draining new pool and restoring warm instances to stable. I added timeline + notes to the release notes doc and flagged for a short postmortem next standup. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
